keyDecisions: ADR-041: editor canvas renders into the dockspace central node with a view transform (u_ViewScale/u_ViewOffset added to quad/outline/handle vertex shaders; identity default keeps output/preview byte-identical). Aspect from the assigned output's effective resolution (portrait auto). Zoom/pan session-only (no .qmap change). Hit-test inverts the same transform so the success-metric warp is preserved.

ADR-042: Simple/Advanced UI mode (EditorState::UiMode, persisted in prefs, default Simple). Per-panel gating, Advanced branch unchanged. Centralized assignMediaToQuad/bindSourceToQuad (fixed a latent bug: dropped videos were created as image sources). Canvas drag-drop uses manual GetDragDropPayload + IsMouseReleased because BeginDragDropTargetCustom can't register over a PassthruCentralNode.

ADR-043: surfacePoint(u,v) is the single render sampler; CORNERS_ONLY quads tessellate 32x32 (kills the diagonal fold). Bezier edges = 8 control-point offsets from the 1/3 & 2/3 points (zero = straight), blended as a Coons patch; amber drag handles; additive .qmap persistence; corner bezier done, grid-line bezier deferred (QM-079).

Undo/redo: reused the dormant CommandHistory + command classes AS-IS (raw Quad* pointers). Made it crash-safe by CLEARING history on quad delete / scene switch (a count/scene guard in Application::render), instead of rewriting commands to be UUID-based. Covers geometry+rename+grid edits. Undoable create/delete deferred (needs Quad::setId + identity-preserving commands).

Video thumbnails: one-shot VideoDecoder.open+decodeNextFrame -> RGBA -> cached RAII Texture (no persistent decoder). Hover-to-play uses ONE dedicated createVideoSource (not getOrCreate) so it never disturbs a quad's assigned video.

lessons: ImGui BeginDragDropTargetCustom cannot register over a PassthruCentralNode (no window is hovered there) — for canvas drops, detect manually via GetDragDropPayload() + IsMouseReleased() over the region rect.

The dormant CommandHistory holds raw Quad* and recreates quads with NEW ids on undo, so undoable delete would dangle/crash. Shipping a SAFE subset (geometry+rename+grid, history cleared on structural change) beats a full-but-crashing undo; full create/delete undo needs Quad::setId + UUID-based commands.

A corner-pin quad is a 1x1 control cell -> 2 triangles -> diagonal fold; decoupling render tessellation from the control grid (sample surfacePoint at 32x32) is the fix, and the same sampler cleanly hosts the bezier Coons patch.

Under desktop-sharing the assistant can't reliably synthetic-drive the app window (VS Code steals foreground); interactive features must be handed to the user for visual verification rather than claimed.
